description.en: A narrated idea, one point per scene, drawn as type.
description.vi: Một ý được kể, mỗi cảnh một điểm, dựng bằng chữ.

script.guidance: Plain, unhurried speech. One idea per scene, each building on the last. A headline that states the idea, and at most one short line under it that adds something the headline does not already say.

draw.guidance: Type is the whole picture. One headline large enough to read at a glance, a quieter line under it, generous space around both. Nothing decorative competes with the words: at most one soft shape or rule in the background.
